title: PowerPoint: choose an OpenAI or Anthropic model when creating or editing with Copilot
summary: The roadmap facts and the three admin paths are supported. The advice incorrectly presents selecting a specific group as keeping Claude off, although that selection enables access for the assigned users. The sources also do not establish the PowerPoint model selector's claimed on-by-default state.

claims.claim: Claude models are currently excluded from applicable in-country processing commitments.
claims.quote: Claude models deployed in Microsoft offerings such as Microsoft Copilot, Researcher, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Copilot in Microsoft 365 apps are currently excluded from the EU Data Boundary, and when applicable, in-country processing commitments.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance

claims.claim: For Anthropic models labelled with Data Retention, Anthropic stores data under its own terms.

claims.claim: Anthropic models with Data Retention require a separate explicit tenant-admin opt-in.
